source_refs.note: Exercise 11.3, Question 10: book page 296. The book prints no answers for Unit 11.

blocks.prompt: 10 (a) A Ferris wheel of radius 20 m rotates with an angular speed of 0.2 rad/sec. Construct its position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh uniform circular motion (ek jaisi raftaar se gol chakkar) ka sawal hai.
Diya kya hai? Radius 20 m aur angular speed 0.2 rad/sec, yani wheel har second 0.2 radian ghoomta hai.
Find kya karna hai? Pahiye ke kinare par baithe musafir ka position vector.
Plan: centre ko origin maano, \(t = 0\) par musafir \((20, 0)\) par, aur wheel anticlockwise; angle \(= \omega t\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(R = 20\) m, \(\omega = 0.2\) rad/s.
Maloom karna: \(\mathbf{r}(t)\).
Tareeqa: \(R\) radius ke circle par \(\theta\) angle wala point \((R\cos\theta, R\sin\theta)\) hota hai; yahan \(\theta = \omega t\).

Axes ka intekhab
Kitab axes tay nahin karti, is liye hum pahiye ke centre ko origin maante hain, \(t = 0\) par musafir \((20, 0)\) par hai, aur pahiya anticlockwise (ghari ki suiyon ke ulat) ghoomta hai.
Kyun: koi bhi intekhab jaiz hai; yeh sab se seedha formula deta hai (wohi shakal jo Question 9 mein thi). Agar centre zameen se \(h\) m ooncha ho to \(\mathbf{r}\) mein sirf \(h\,\hat{j}\) jurta hai, aur velocity aur acceleration nahin badalte.

Position vector
\[\theta = \omega t = 0.2t\]
\[\mathbf{r}(t) = 20\cos(0.2t)\,\hat{i}\]
\[\quad + 20\sin(0.2t)\,\hat{j}\]
Kyun: \(t\) seconds mein pahiya \(0.2t\) radian ghoom jata hai; maslan 10 seconds mein 2 radian.

Tasdeeq
\(|\mathbf{r}(t)| = \sqrt{400\cos^{2}(0.2t) + 400\sin^{2}(0.2t)} = 20\): musafir hamesha kinare par, centre se 20 m door rehta hai, jaisa hona chahiye. Ek chakkar kitni der mein? Poora chakkar \(2\pi\) radian hai, to waqt \(\frac{2\pi}{0.2} = 10\pi \approx 31.4\) seconds. Yani pahiya taqreeban aadhe minute mein ek chakkar poora karta hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 20\cos(0.2t)\,\hat{i} + 20\sin(0.2t)\,\hat{j}\) metres (centre origin par, \(t = 0\) par musafir \((20, 0)\) par, anticlockwise).

blocks.prompt: 10 (b) A Ferris wheel of radius 20 m rotates with an angular speed of 0.2 rad/sec. Find the passenger's velocity at \(t = 10\) sec.
blocks.explanation:
Velocity position ka derivative hai; position part (a) mein mil gayi.
Diya kya hai? \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 20\cos(0.2t)\,\hat{i} + 20\sin(0.2t)\,\hat{j}\).
Find kya karna hai? \(t = 10\) second par musafir ki velocity.
Plan: chain rule se differentiate karo, phir \(t = 10\) rakho; angle 2 radian banega, is liye calculator RAD mode mein.
steps:
Velocity
\[\mathbf{v}(t) = -20(0.2)\sin(0.2t)\,\hat{i}\]
\[\quad + 20(0.2)\cos(0.2t)\,\hat{j}\]
\[= -4\sin(0.2t)\,\hat{i} + 4\cos(0.2t)\,\hat{j}\]
Kyun: chain rule: andar wale \(0.2t\) ka derivative 0.2 bahar aata hai, aur \(20 \times 0.2 = 4\).

\(t = 10\) par
\[0.2 \times 10 = 2 \text{ radians}\]
\[\mathbf{v}(10) = -4\sin 2\,\hat{i} + 4\cos 2\,\hat{j}\]
\[\approx -3.637\,\hat{i} - 1.665\,\hat{j}\]
Kyun: radian mode mein \(\sin 2 \approx 0.9093\) aur \(\cos 2 \approx -0.4161\).
Dhyan dein: degree mode mein \(\sin 2^{\circ} \approx 0.0349\) aa jata hai jo yahan bilkul ghalat hai; 0.2 rad/sec ki wajah se angle radian mein hai.

Matlab aur tasdeeq
\[|\mathbf{v}| = \sqrt{16\sin^{2}2 + 16\cos^{2}2} = 4 \text{ m/s}\]
Yeh \(R\omega = 20 \times 0.2 = 4\) ke barabar hai, jo circular motion ka mashhoor formula hai. \(t = 10\) par musafir taqreeban \((-8.32, 18.19)\) par, yani pahiye ke upar baayen hisse mein hai, aur baayen aur neeche ki taraf ja raha hai (figure dekhiye).

answer_figure.alt: Circle of radius 20 centred at the origin. The passenger P at t = 10 s is at about (-8.32, 18.19) in the upper left; a red arrow shows the velocity pointing left and down along the tangent, and a green arrow points from P towards the centre.
answer_figure.caption: Ferris wheel r(t) = 20 cos(0.2t) i + 20 sin(0.2t) j: at t = 10 s the velocity is tangent and the acceleration points to the centre (arrows scaled; original drawing)

blocks.prompt: 10 (c) A Ferris wheel of radius 20 m rotates with an angular speed of 0.2 rad/sec. Show that the acceleration is centripetal (toward the center).
blocks.explanation:
Centripetal ka matlab hai markaz (centre) ki taraf. Centre origin par hai, to markaz ki taraf wali simt \(-\mathbf{r}\) hai.
Diya kya hai? Part (b) ki velocity \(\mathbf{v}(t) = -4\sin(0.2t)\,\hat{i} + 4\cos(0.2t)\,\hat{j}\).
Saabit kya karna hai? Acceleration hamesha centre ki taraf hai.
Plan: \(\mathbf{a}(t)\) nikalo aur use \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) ka negative multiple likh kar dikhao, bilkul Question 7(c) ki tarah.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\mathbf{v}(t) = -4\sin(0.2t)\,\hat{i} + 4\cos(0.2t)\,\hat{j}\).
Saabit karna: har \(t\) par \(\mathbf{a}(t)\) centre ki taraf hai.
Tareeqa: Question 7(c) wala.

Acceleration
\[\mathbf{a}(t) = -0.8\cos(0.2t)\,\hat{i}\]
\[\quad - 0.8\sin(0.2t)\,\hat{j}\]
\[= -0.04\left[20\cos(0.2t)\,\hat{i}\right.\]
\[\quad \left. + 20\sin(0.2t)\,\hat{j}\right]\]
\[= -0.04\,\mathbf{r}(t)\]
Kyun: dobara chain rule: \(4 \times 0.2 = 0.8\). Phir \(0.8 = 0.04 \times 20\) likh kar \(-0.04\) common nikala to bracket mein poora \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) aa gaya. Ghaur kijiye \(0.04 = (0.2)^{2} = \omega^{2}\).

Simt
\(\mathbf{r}(t)\) centre se musafir ki taraf hai, to us ka negative multiple \(-0.04\,\mathbf{r}(t)\) musafir se centre ki taraf hai, har lamhe. Yahi centripetal acceleration hai.
Kyun: negative number se multiply karne se simt ulat jati hai. Asal mein pahiye ka dhaancha (frame) musafir ko andar ki taraf kheenchta rehta hai; agar yeh kheench na ho to musafir tangent ki seedh mein seedha nikal jaye. Isi andar ki kheench ka naam centripetal acceleration hai.
Dhyan dein: sirf \(t = 10\) par check karna kaafi nahin; \(\mathbf{a}(t) = -0.04\,\mathbf{r}(t)\) har \(t\) ke liye sach hai, isi liye yeh saboot poora hai.

Miqdaar aur tasdeeq
\[|\mathbf{a}| = 0.04 \times 20 = 0.8 \text{ m/s}^{2}\]
\[\dfrac{v^{2}}{R} = \dfrac{4^{2}}{20} = 0.8 \text{ m/s}^{2}\]
Physics wala formula \(\frac{v^{2}}{R}\) aur hamara calculus wala jawab barabar hain.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(\mathbf{a}(t) = -0.04\,\mathbf{r}(t)\), jo musafir se centre ki taraf hai, is liye acceleration centripetal hai; \(|\mathbf{a}| = 0.8\) m/s\(^{2}\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 11.3 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain (Unit 11 ki kisi exercise ke jawab kitab mein nahin hain). Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) jaise angles radians mein hain, is liye calculator RAD mode mein rakhein. Apna hal yahan wale hal se mila kar dekhiye.
